exempt.reason: a snapshot of the project's cumulative API spend ledger at run time, including spend by later phases; not a property of the run
what that invocation took from the response cache versus paid for; a rebuild takes every response from the cache
the Ollama server version asked at run time; a replay does not query the server (the weights digest per arm comes from the cached responses and is compared)
Qdrant's on-disk size (du of its storage) depends on segment and write-ahead-log state when measured; the FAISS index sizes are compared
FAISS-vs-Qdrant exact-order agreement on 30 queries: Qdrant orders exactly tied scores arbitrarily between builds, so a tied pair flips it between 29 and 30 (DECISIONS.md, Phases 2 and 7)
retrieval score of a context chunk, stored to 6 decimals; the chunks and their order are compared exactly
a question's top-1 retrieval score (6 decimals); the Q1 statistics are compared
stored ranking beyond the top 5: a near-tied pair (score gap < 1e-7) can swap places; every metric of the row is compared and must match
